authority_boundary: Exact visible text is preserved for grounding; all other fields are research annotations and are not source wording.
claim_relevant_visible_text:
ROSELAND, N.J., Aug. 28, 2024 /PRNewswire/ -- CoreWeave, the AI Hyperscaler™, today announced that it is the first cloud provider to bring NVIDIA H200 Tensor Core GPUs to market.
CoreWeave's H200 instances combine NVIDIA H200 GPUs with Intel's fifth-generation Xeon CPUs (Emerald Rapids) and 3200Gbps of NVIDIA Quantum-2 InfiniBand networking, and are deployed in clusters with up to 42,000 GPUs and accelerated storage solutions to deliver powerful performance and enable customers to dramatically lower their time and cost to train their GenAI models.
precision_guard: This establishes that CoreWeave reported bringing NVIDIA H200 GPUs to market and deploying H200 instances by the August 28, 2024 vintage. It does not establish that H200 platform shipments began in calendar Q2 2024, does not identify Micron as the HBM supplier in the deployed instances, and does not prove a named-customer qualification event.
researcher_paraphrase: CoreWeave said it was the first cloud provider to bring NVIDIA H200 GPUs to market and that its H200 instances were deployed in large clusters by the August 28, 2024 announcement.
source_title: CoreWeave First to Market with NVIDIA H200 Tensor Core GPUs, Ushering in a New Era of AI Infrastructure Performance
